aiNative.redirectRefused: The local AI runtime redirected the request. Forwarding was refused; refresh and retry.
aiNative.requestFailed: The AI service request did not finish: {{error}}
aiNative.http1Hint: For custom endpoints with unstable HTTP/2. TLS verification remains enabled.
aiNative.inlineImages: Send DeepSeek images inline each turn
aiNative.inlineImagesHint: When off, DeepSeek's own API uploads images once and reuses their file IDs.
aiNative.passErrors: Let the caller handle upstream errors
aiNative.passErrorsHint: Preserve vendor errors without retries, failover or resting keys for those errors.
aiNative.keepSelf: Allow routing back to this gateway
aiNative.keepSelfHint: Only for a remote Magpie provider that points to itself. Excluded by default to avoid loops.
aiNative.useFirst: Prefer this provider in Smart routing
aiNative.useFirstHint: Quota, rate-limit and availability protections still apply.
aiNative.accountModelsAll: Keep explicit all-model choices for keys
aiNative.accountModelsAllHint: Maps key IDs to explicit all-model choices so fetching models does not narrow them.
aiNative.invalidRuntime: AI services returned an invalid local runtime address. Refresh the page.
aiNative.invalidResponse: AI services returned an invalid response. Try again.
aiNative.responseTooLarge: The response is too large. Narrow the query.
aiNative.passUserAgentHint: Pass the caller’s identity by default. When off, use Magpie’s identity.
aiNative.ownBalanceHint: When the provider reports no balance, subtract estimated spending since this entry. A provider-reported balance takes precedence.
aiNative.socketHint: For Responses endpoints. A failed connection uses HTTP; automatic mode temporarily avoids servers that refuse the handshake.
aiNative.resolveHint: Set destinations for the service's host name, one IP, IP:port or dns:host per line. Keep the original host and certificate name. A proxy connects by itself.
aiNative.resolveHost: Host name in the service address
aiNative.certificatesHint: For a custom HTTPS service or remote Magpie. Files stay in their original location. A client certificate and private key may share one PEM file.
aiNative.serverPinHint: Leave empty for normal certificate checks. Once set, only this certificate is accepted; read and trust it again when the server changes its certificate.
aiNative.noStandIn: Refuse fallback requests from other providers
aiNative.noStandInHint: A failed request from an ordinary provider is not sent here. Requests that start here can still use fallback services.
aiNative.upstreamProviders: Show original providers in remote model names
aiNative.upstreamProvidersHint: For remote Magpie. Distinguish identical model names by their original provider. Model IDs stay the same.
aiNative.noBalanceProbeHint: Do not probe a custom service for a balance endpoint when no balance URL is set.
aiNative.windowAmountHint: Use the vendor's unit for this window, such as credits, requests or tokens. Each window uses one cap type.
aiNative.accessOnly: Use the current access token without renewal
aiNative.accessOnlyHint: Keep the original tool signed in. Import again after the token expires. Requires a ChatGPT / Codex file with a valid access token.
aiNative.importRotates: Import renews the ChatGPT / Codex login token. The original tool may need to sign in again.
aiNative.accountFilesTooLarge: Account files must total no more than 8 MiB.
aiNative.import.failed: Import failed; check the file or sign in again
aiNative.exportHint: Exported files contain login credentials. Give them only to tools you trust. Renewing a ChatGPT / Codex account in another tool may require signing in here again.
aiNative.exportSkipped: Not exported; no usable login record
aiNative.keyServiceTier: Service tier for this gateway key
aiNative.keyAliasesHint: A client can request a model by its alias. The gateway key's model restrictions still apply.
